purpose: Guide independent post-run judgment of the paired native-versus-Python circular-line-array product screen without providing semantic feedback to either Actor.
rules: Judge each row independently after its Actor process has ended and its evidence has been sealed.
Cite retained evidence for every observed claim.
Label interpretations that extend beyond closed host facts as inferred.
Use unresolved when retained evidence cannot support a judgment.
Do not award efficiency credit when semantic or evidence quality regresses.
Do not feed any judgment, question, disposition, or expected answer back to either Actor during execution.

Do retained observations support even angular spacing at Radius with Start Angle controlling phase?
Do retained observations support line segments whose vertical extent is governed by Height?
Did the model exercise Count and Height, observe consequential effects, and restore the chosen defaults?
Did the model remain in its assigned native or Python authoring lane without an implementation-mode switch?
Did a final receipt-fenced observation precede goal.complete with no later gateway call?
